items.l1: The Great Wall is in northern China, and it is very, very long.
items.notes: Faithful; gap is only 很长很长 vs 非常非常长, both render 'very, very long'.

items.l1: It quickly became popular and was used in multiple countries.
items.notes: Gold says 多个国家 (multiple/several), reference overstated it as 'many'; changed 'many' to 'multiple'.

items.l1: If we buy a little less clothing, we can save water.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's 就 clause is an implied conditional, so 'If' is right; 省水 vs 节约用水 is synonym variance.

items.l1: Put the kitchen waste into the box.
items.notes: Faithful; low score is only 箱子 vs 盒子 and 厨余 vs 厨余垃圾, all valid for 'box' and 'kitchen waste'.

items.l1: After a few weeks, the kitchen waste will turn into dark soil.
items.notes: Faithful; 黑黑的土 vs 黑色的土 and 过几周 vs 几个星期以后 are stylistic variants of the same content.

items.l1: It can also help plants grow.
items.notes: Faithful; gold drops the subject (composting), English needs 'It', which back-translates as an added 它.

items.l1: The wooden horse made children's playtime more fun.
items.notes: Faithful; 儿童/孩子们 and 时光/时间 are synonym choices only.

items.l1: It looks a little like a windmill, but its function is different.
items.notes: Faithful; 和风车看起来有点像 vs 看起来有点像风车 is word-order variance, 作用 = function.

items.l1: Good resource management lets agriculture go on and on.
items.notes: 'keep going all the time' reads as frequency, not the sustained continuation of 一直做下去; changed to 'go on and on'.

items.l1: A match is competition.
items.notes: Faithful; my blind back-translation matched the gold exactly (比赛就是竞争), so the 0.24 was first-reviewer variance.

items.l1: When you play games, you should have fun.
items.notes: Gold 要开心 is about the player's enjoyment; 'Playing games should be fun' moved focus to the game (有趣), so made the player the subject.

items.l1: A few small holes need to be made in the bottom of the box for drainage and ventilation.
items.notes: 'for drainage and air' was loose for 透气 and 'must' too strong for 要; now 'ventilation', 'need to', and 'bottom of the box'.

items.l1: Parks, community gardens, and even the greening systems on building facades and rooftops, traditionally regarded as "non-productive spaces", are being deeply embedded in the urban capital cycle through multiple value chains.
items.notes: Faithful; my blind back-translation was near-identical to the gold, so the low score was variance on a long sentence.

items.l1: Their characteristic of being located close to end consumers greatly reduces logistics losses and the carbon footprint, forming a resilient alternative to fragile global supply chains.
items.notes: Faithful; 压缩 vs 降低 and 消费终端 vs 终端消费者 are lexical variants of the same claim.

items.l1: Mixed-use development is being redefined: a commercial complex integrating a vertical farm is no longer merely a display of corporate social responsibility, but becomes a business strategy for attracting high-end tenants and increasing brand stickiness.
items.notes: Gold is mixed script, with an English gloss （mixed-use development） inside the Chinese, which also lowers the score; reference itself is faithful and unchanged.

items.l1: Shops keep selling new clothes, so people keep buying.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's 就 gives the consequence that 'so' expresses, and the gap is only 所以 vs 就.

items.l1: If we buy a little less clothing, we can save water and can also help the Earth.
items.notes: Meaning was faithful, but 'a little fewer clothes' is ungrammatical; fixed to 'a little less clothing'. The low score was synonym variance (省水/节约用水).

items.l1: However, there are still many problems.
items.notes: Faithful; 问题依然很多 and 还有很多问题 are the same statement, and the natural English cannot keep the gold's topic-comment order.

items.l1: However, technological innovation, without a simultaneous change in consumption concepts, will ultimately struggle to move forward.
items.notes: Faithful; gold uses literary 若无/举步维艰 where the back-translation used plain 如果没有/难以推进, same meaning.

items.l1: The answer perhaps lies hidden in reflection on the inertia of consumerism and in the persistent pursuit of supply chain justice.
items.notes: 'lies in' lost the gold's image 藏在…之中 (hidden in); restored it as 'lies hidden in'.

items.l1: This is musical notation.
items.notes: Faithful; 'musical notation' is the correct term for 记谱法, and back-translating to 乐谱 (sheet music) is a back-translator slip, not a loose reference.

items.l1: Over a long time, musical notation became simpler.
items.notes: Faithful; gap is the 记谱法/乐谱 term and the plain 时间很久 vs 经过很长时间, both 'over a long time'.

items.l1: However, in many Mediterranean, Middle Eastern and Latin American societies, time shows the characteristics of "polychronic time".
items.notes: Gold is mixed script, with an English gloss （polychronic time） inside the Chinese; reference itself is faithful and unchanged.

items.l1: As the world becomes ever "faster", perhaps the deepest wisdom lies precisely in learning to ferry calmly through the differing currents of time.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's compressed literary 差异的时流 vs the back-translation's 不同的时间之流 is stylistic, every element is kept.

items.l1: Traditional plastics are made of long-chain polymers, which are extremely hard to break in the natural environment, leading to the accumulation of pollution that does not decay for hundreds of years.
items.notes: Faithful; my blind back-translation was near-identical to the gold, so the 0.69 was only marginal variance.
